If players can just "ask out" and have their trade request granted immediately, they should have negotiated that option into the CBA.

It was spreading in a somewhat uniform fashion, though. Over the last year or so every player type has been getting more money and a normal amount of cap had been spent all things considered. That would’ve included these young 1C types who were seemingly in line to hit in that $12-15 million range which wasn’t overly different from the past either.

This isn’t the first time a young 1C has been paid like a normal 1C but this is pretty much unprecedented because of the level of player he is. McDavid was the highest AAV player in the game on his second contract but he’s McDavid and he probably wouldn’t have been the highest if Crosby and Ovechkin didn’t sign such long deals. Those two were in the same boat on their second deals but these three are actually fitting for the generational billing, they’re a bit different. I love Leo to death but he’s not that and even as a percentage of cap he’s went past all of them. I don’t think there was anything inevitable about it, this is a completely brand new territory that could’ve pretty easily been avoided.
